blocks.text: In nervous system, neurons follow specific neural pathways (arcs) to receive, transmit and process impulses. Neural pathways may compose of only a few neurons, or may be more complex networks. The reflex arc is the simplest neural pathway. It controls reflex action i.e., immediate, automatic and involuntary responses to external and internal stimuli.
